npcs.name: 王阿姨
npcs.role: your landlady at the courtyard house
npcs.character: Warm, practical, talks a little fast when she is pleased. Has lived in this courtyard all her life and treats you like a nephew or niece from far away.
knows: Everyone in 帽儿胡同 by name
The 早点铺 on 南锣鼓巷 has the best 包子
The old lantern in the yard is a 走马灯 her grandfather, a lantern maker, made and painted for her when she was small
The subway station is at the east end of 南锣鼓巷
wants: Someone to mend the old lantern
News of her son, who works abroad

explains.灯笼: 晚上用的红色的灯，门口有，过年也有。
explains.胡同: 北京的小路，两边是老房子。
explains.四合院: 北京的老房子，中间有一个院子。
explains.倒: 上面的到下面了，下面的到上面了。

npcs.name: 早点铺师傅
npcs.role: the cook at the breakfast shop
npcs.character: Busy and cheerful, hands never still; short sentences, says the price before you ask.
knows: 包子 2 yuan, 豆浆 2 yuan, 油条 1.5 yuan
The breakfast rush is 7 to 9
The old man with the bird cage comes every morning
wants: You to try the 油条 while it is hot
People to queue, not crowd the counter

explains.包子: 里面有肉或者菜，热的，早上吃。

npcs.name: 李阿姨
npcs.role: the woman who runs the little corner shop
npcs.character: Calm, sharp-eyed, knows every rumour of the lane but tells them slowly, as if they were nothing.
knows: Prices of water, cola, bread, milk
People say the stone lion at the square moves at night
A 交通卡 is bought at the station
wants: Customers to pay by phone, not with big notes

explains.交通卡: 坐地铁的卡，在地铁站买。

npcs.name: 张师傅
npcs.role: the barber on 南锣鼓巷
npcs.character: Dry humour, modest about his work, likes to test your Chinese with small jokes.
knows: He opened the shop thirty years ago
马马虎虎 is how he answers 'how is business'
wants: Someone to laugh at his jokes

explains.一心一意: 只想一个东西，不想别的。

npcs.name: 老刘
npcs.role: the owner of the teahouse
npcs.character: Slow, deliberate, pours tea as if nothing else in the world mattered. Speaks in short, careful sentences.
knows: The stone lion by the Drum Tower is older than the tower's last repairs
At night the lion's eyes shine
Making tea needs 一心一意
wants: Guests who sit and drink slowly
To hear what the young people say about the lantern spirits

explains.石狮子: 石头做的狮子，在大门两边。
explains.神: 天上的人，很老很老，人看不见。

npcs.name: 赵爷爷
npcs.role: the old man who walks his bird every morning
npcs.character: Cheerful, proud of his bird, happy to point the way and tell stories.
knows: The subway station is east, at the end of 南锣鼓巷
The Drum Tower square is west
Stories of the old Beijing

npcs.name: 小明
npcs.role: a boy from the lane, eight years old
npcs.character: Curious, fearless, asks you questions back. Believes every ghost story.
knows: The stone lion winks at night — he saw it
Where the pigeons sleep
wants: Someone to play with after school

explains.石狮子: 大门那儿的狮子，石头的！

npcs.name: 游客
npcs.role: a tourist from Shanghai, taking photos
npcs.character: Friendly, a little lost, happy to find someone to talk to.
knows: Where the tea shop is
Nothing about the lane
misses: 对不起，我也不是北京人。

npcs.name: 游客
npcs.role: a tourist from Chengdu, with her friend
npcs.character: Chatty, loves food, compares everything with home.
knows: The 早点铺 is good

npcs.name: 三轮车师傅
npcs.role: the 三轮车 tricycle driver who gives lane tours
npcs.character: Loud, friendly, Beijing through and through; always offering a ride.
knows: Every lane of the old city
The Drum Tower was where time was told with drums

explains.鼓楼: 有很大的鼓的楼，以前用来说时间。

npcs.name: 外卖小哥
npcs.role: a food delivery rider, always in a hurry
npcs.character: Rushed but polite; answers in a word or two while checking his phone.
knows: Every door number in the lane

npcs.name: 跳舞的阿姨
npcs.role: a woman who dances on the square in the evening
npcs.character: Energetic; one line, then back to her music.
knows: Dancing starts after dinner
wants: You to join the dance one day

npcs.name: 拍照的人
npcs.role: a man photographing the towers
npcs.character: Absorbed in his camera; answers without looking up.
knows: The towers look best in the evening
wants: People to step out of his picture

npcs.name: 工作人员
npcs.role: the station attendant at 南锣鼓巷
npcs.character: Clear, patient, used to tourists; speaks slowly and points.
knows: A 交通卡 costs a 20 yuan deposit plus what you put on it
Line 6 and line 8 stop here
For 天安门东, take line 8, then line 1
wants: Passengers to tap in at the gate

explains.押金: 先给的钱，不用卡的时候还给你。
explains.换乘: 从一个地铁换到别的地铁。

npcs.name: 卖糖葫芦的大叔
npcs.role: a man selling candied haws on sticks
npcs.character: Sing-song street seller.
knows: Candied haws are best in winter

explains.糖葫芦: 红色的小果子，外面有糖，很甜。

npcs.name: 下棋的爷爷
npcs.role: an old man playing Chinese chess on a stool in the lane
npcs.character: Loud, happy to lose to a beginner, very unhappy to lose to his neighbour.
knows: 马走日, 象走田 — the horse moves like 日, the elephant like 田

npcs.name: 收破烂儿的师傅
npcs.role: the recycler who rides his tricycle through the hutongs, calling out
npcs.character: Cheerful, knows everyone’s old things and everyone’s news.
knows: Who has moved, who has thrown out what

npcs.name: 祥子
npcs.role: a young 三轮车 man saving for a tricycle of his own
npcs.character: Quiet, strong, stubbornly hopeful.
knows: Every lane of the old city
wants: A 三轮车 of his own

explains.三轮车: 三个轮子的车，可以拉人。

npcs.name: 喝茶的客人
npcs.role: a teahouse regular who cannot stop talking about the news
npcs.character: Excitable, friendly, easily steered.
knows: Everything in the papers

npcs.name: 说书的先生
npcs.role: a storyteller who tells the Three Kingdoms in the teahouse, one episode a day
npcs.character: A voice like a drum; stops at the best moment.
knows: The whole of the Three Kingdoms

npcs.name: 白先生
npcs.role: a gentle man in plain white who collects scrap with the recycler
npcs.character: Endlessly unlucky and never complains; kind to everyone, including people who are not kind back.
knows: An old shrine at the end of the lane, forgotten for years

npcs.name: 红衣人
npcs.role: a young man in red who is only ever seen after dark
npcs.character: Quiet, amused, fiercely protective of the man in white — who does not seem to know him.
knows: The ghost market at 潘家园

npcs.name: 文创店的姐姐
npcs.role: a young woman who runs a little gift shop on 南锣鼓巷
npcs.character: Chatty; draws the designs herself.
knows: What everything on the rack costs
wants: To see you in something that suits you

nodes.translate: Hello! What would you like?
nodes.why: 李阿姨小卖部: 水 2 元 · 小鱼干 3 元 · 鱼饵 5 元 · 竹竿 10 元 · 手电筒 15 元 · 保温杯 20 元 · 雨伞 15 元 · 花 10 元 · 剪纸 10 元 · 红包 5 元 · 春联 10 元 · 福 5 元. Say what you want and how many — 「两个包子」, 「一瓶水」 — ask 「多少钱？」 any time, and say 「不要了」 when that is all.

nodes.translate: Hello! What would you like?
nodes.why: 早点铺: 包子 3 元 · 豆浆 3 元 · 油条 3 元. Say what you want and how many — 「两个包子」, 「一瓶水」 — ask 「多少钱？」 any time, and say 「不要了」 when that is all.

nodes.translate: Hello! What would you like?
nodes.why: 糖葫芦: 糖葫芦 10 元. Say what you want and how many — 「两个包子」, 「一瓶水」 — ask 「多少钱？」 any time, and say 「不要了」 when that is all.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: So this is my new room!
nodes.why: 你 arrive in Beijing. The companion button (bottom left) is 兔儿爷 — he wakes up soon. Tap words for their cards; tap 拼 for pinyin.

nodes.say: 你好！你是新来的吧？我是王阿姨。
nodes.translate: Hello! You must be the new one? I'm Auntie Wang.
nodes.why: 吧 at the end makes a guess: 'you're the new one, right?'. 阿姨 is how you address a woman of your parents' age.

nodes.translate: What's your name?
nodes.why: 叫 is 'to be called'. Answer with 我叫 + your name — she will remember it.

nodes.say: 好！你的房间在那儿。你吃早饭了吗？
nodes.translate: Good! Your room is over there. Have you had breakfast?
nodes.why: 吃了吗 — 'have you eaten?' — is also just a friendly hello in Beijing.

nodes.say: 南锣鼓巷有一个早点铺，包子很好吃！去吃吧。
nodes.translate: On 南锣鼓巷 there's a breakfast shop, the buns are great! Go and eat.
nodes.why: 吧 here is a friendly push: 'go on, eat!'. 南锣鼓巷 is east of our lane.

nodes.say: 好！那去南锣鼓巷看看吧。早点铺的包子很好吃！
nodes.translate: Good! Then go and look around 南锣鼓巷. The buns at the breakfast shop are great!

nodes.say: 去早点铺吃早饭吧！在南锣鼓巷。
nodes.translate: Go and have breakfast at the breakfast shop! It's on 南锣鼓巷.

nodes.say: 你看，这个灯笼是我爷爷做的。
nodes.translate: Look — my grandfather made this lantern.
nodes.why: 是……的 says who did it: 我爷爷做的 — it was my grandfather who made it.

nodes.translate: Oh no… the lantern broke!

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 你好。我是兔儿爷。我也在灯笼里。
nodes.translate: Hello. I am 兔儿爷, the rabbit. I was in the lantern too.
nodes.why: 兔儿爷 is Beijing's clay rabbit of the Mid-Autumn festival — a small guardian. He speaks English with you from now on (tap him, bottom left).

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 灯笼里的小神都跑了，跑到北京的胡同里了。
nodes.translate: The little spirits in the lantern have all run off — into the hutongs of Beijing.
nodes.why: A key line 📌: 神 (spirit, god) and 胡同 (the old lanes) are hard. Ask people: “神是什么意思？” — or tap them.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: Let's go and find them!

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 你问问人吧。他们看见了什么？
nodes.translate: Ask people. What have they seen?

nodes.speaker: wang-ayi
nodes.say: 这本书给你。书里有很多灯笼。
nodes.translate: This book is for you. It has lots of lanterns in it.
nodes.why: 给你 — for you. 王阿姨 gives you 《灯笼》: how a 走马灯 turns, and the lantern night of 元宵节. It goes on the 书架 in your room.

nodes.translate: That lantern… never mind, never mind. Go and have fun!

nodes.say: 早！要什么？包子、豆浆、油条都有。
nodes.translate: Morning! What'll it be? Buns, soy milk, fried dough sticks — we've got them all.
nodes.why: 要 is “want” — 我要 + how many + the food: 「我要一个包子，一杯豆浆」. Ask 「多少钱？」 any time; say 「不要了」 when that is all.

nodes.say: 好了，给你！好吃吗？下次再来。
nodes.translate: There you are! Good? Come again.
Hello! What would you like?
nodes.why: 看见 is 'to see (and notice)'. Ask what people have seen.

nodes.say: 水三块。给你。你还要什么？
nodes.translate: Water's 3 yuan. Here. Anything else?

nodes.say: 听说晚上鼓楼那儿的石狮子会动。
nodes.translate: They say at night the stone lion over by the Drum Tower moves.
nodes.why: A key line 📌: 听说 is 'I've heard / they say'. 会动 is 'can move'. 鼓楼 is the Drum Tower, west of your lane.

nodes.say: 我不知道。晚上，你去看看吧！
nodes.translate: I don't know. Go and see at night!
OK, bye!

words.explain: 石头的狮子，在大门两边。

nodes.translate: Come, sit.

nodes.say: 晚上，鼓楼的石狮子会动。很多人看见了。
nodes.translate: At night the Drum Tower's stone lion moves. Lots of people have seen it.

nodes.say: 你想看吗？在这儿坐，晚上再去。
nodes.translate: Want to see it? Sit here, and go when it's night.

nodes.say: 现在是晚上了。去看看石狮子吧！
nodes.translate: It's night now. Go and see the stone lion!
All right. Come back in the evening.

words.explain: 石头做的狮子，在大门两边。

nodes.translate: Come, sit. Some tea?
Tea wants your whole heart.
nodes.why: A 成语 📌: 一心一意 — 'one heart, one mind': doing one thing with all your attention. It is in your 成语 book now.

nodes.translate: Is it good?
Good! Come again.
All right, next time.
Morning! Look — isn't my bird pretty?
nodes.why: The old men of Beijing take their birds for a walk in the morning, cage and all.

nodes.translate: Thanks! Where are you off to?
nodes.why: 请问 — 'may I ask' — opens any question to a stranger.

nodes.translate: The Drum Tower is to the west, not far.
nodes.why: 西边 is 'the west side'. From 南锣鼓巷, walk back through your lane and on.

nodes.translate: The subway station is to the east.

nodes.say: 你好！鼓楼在西边，地铁在东边。
nodes.translate: Hello! The Drum Tower's west, the subway's east.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: So this is the Drum Tower! It's big!
nodes.why: 鼓楼 — the Drum Tower — told Beijing the time with drums; the 钟楼 (Bell Tower) beside it with a bell. A landmark stamp for your passport.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 石狮子在睡觉。晚上再来看石狮子吧。
nodes.translate: The stone lion is asleep. Come back and see it at night.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: The stone lion doesn't move. Is it asleep?

nodes.speaker: shishizi
nodes.translate: Someone's here? Who are you?

nodes.speaker: shishizi
nodes.say: 你想和我做朋友吗？你说：一个日，一个月，是什么字？
nodes.simpler: 一个日，一个月，是什么字？
nodes.translate: You want to be my friend? Then tell me: a sun and a moon — what character is that?
nodes.why: A 灯谜, a character riddle: 日 (sun) + 月 (moon) side by side make 明 — bright.

nodes.speaker: shishizi
nodes.say: 对！是明！你是我的朋友了。
nodes.translate: Right! It's 明! You're my friend now.

nodes.speaker: shishizi
nodes.translate: Hello, friend!
Hello! How's your Chinese?
Me too — 马马虎虎, so-so! Have a seat.
nodes.why: A 成语 📌: 马马虎虎 — 'horse horse tiger tiger' — means so-so. It is a joke: he is a very good barber.

nodes.translate: I'm tired today — see you tomorrow!
Hello! Taking the subway?
Do you have a transport card?

nodes.say: 好的。交通卡：押金二十，充值二十，四十块。好吗？
nodes.simpler: 押金二十，充值二十。你要交通卡吗？
nodes.translate: Sure. Transport card: 20 deposit, 20 on the card — 40 yuan. OK?
nodes.why: 押金 is a deposit — you get it back when you return the card. 充值 is topping the card up.

nodes.say: 这是你的交通卡。刷卡，进站。
nodes.translate: Here's your transport card. Tap it at the gate to go in.
nodes.why: 刷卡 — tap the card. 进站 — enter the station. The gates are just below.

nodes.translate: All right — come back any time.

words.explain: 先给的钱，不用卡的时候还给你。

nodes.translate: Hello! The trains are this way.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: Go to sleep?

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: Right — sleep. See you tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: Not now.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: Tap the card — in you go!

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: You haven't got a transport card.
nodes.why: The attendant by the ticket machines sells the 交通卡.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: Right — out through the gates.

nodes.say: 你好……我感冒了，有点发烧。
nodes.translate: Hello… I've caught a cold, a bit of a fever.
It's nothing, nothing. Off you go.
You bought me medicine?
Thank you! You're so kind.

words.explain: 身体不好的时候吃的东西。

nodes.translate: You want to go to the palace?

nodes.say: 故宫的票要在网上买，要写你的名字和护照。
nodes.translate: Palace tickets are bought online, with your name and passport.

nodes.say: 我帮你买吧！你的护照呢？
nodes.translate: I'll buy it for you! Your passport?

nodes.say: 好了！明天上午九点，你的票在手机上。
nodes.translate: Done! Tomorrow at nine in the morning — the ticket's on your phone.

words.explain: 去别的国家要用的小本子。

nodes.say: 你好！交通卡要充值吗？五十块。
nodes.translate: Hello! Top up your transport card? Fifty yuan.

nodes.say: 好了！你的交通卡有钱了。
nodes.translate: Done! Your card is topped up.
OK, bye!

nodes.say: 我的鸟不见了！你看见了吗？
nodes.translate: My bird's gone! Have you seen it?
nodes.why: A small key line: 不见了 — 'has gone, can't be found'. 小明 is always in the lanes: ask him.

nodes.translate: Is this grandpa's bird? Here!
My bird! Thank you!
A haircut? Thirty yuan.
Done! Looks great!
All right, next time.

nodes.say: 这是给我的画吗？真好看！谢谢！
nodes.translate: A painting for me? It's beautiful! Thank you!

onEnter.note: gave her a painting of the White Dagoba

nodes.translate: I want a storybook!
My storybook! Thank you!
What would you like?
Tea leaves? Twenty yuan. Here.

nodes.say: 我的风筝在树上！你能帮我吗？
nodes.translate: My kite's stuck in a tree! Can you help me?
nodes.why: The tree is the big 槐树 in your lane, 帽儿胡同. A bamboo pole would reach it.

words.explain: 在天上飞的纸，有一根长线。
很高，绿色的，有很多叶子。

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: There — the kite's down!

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: There's a kite in the tree.

words.explain: 很高，绿色的，有很多叶子。

nodes.translate: My kite! Thank you!

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: Where are my keys? Gone!
nodes.why: Ask the neighbours if they have seen them: 李阿姨 at the shop, 赵爷爷, 小明.

nodes.say: 我没看见。你问问小明吧。
nodes.translate: I haven't seen them. Ask 小明.

nodes.say: 我看见了！钥匙在胡同那儿，那儿很黑。
nodes.translate: I saw them! The keys are in the lane, where it's dark.
nodes.why: The dark corner is at the east end of 帽儿胡同. A torch 手电筒 from the corner shop would help.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: My keys! Here they are!
Hot water? Here you are.

nodes.say: 你能给我拍一张红门的照片吗？
nodes.translate: Could you take a photo of a red gate for me?
nodes.why: 拍 (take a photo) and 张 (the measure word for flat things) are HSK 3 — a small key line. Use your 手机 on the door gods' gate in 大栅栏.

nodes.say: 这个照片真好看！谢谢你！
nodes.translate: What a lovely photo! Thank you!

nodes.say: 我们是朋友了吧？你叫什么名字？
nodes.translate: We're friends now, right? What's your name?
nodes.why: Tell them your name: 我叫 + name. From now on they will greet you by it.

nodes.translate: {name} — a good name! I will remember it.

nodes.say: 我们是朋友了！你叫什么名字？
nodes.translate: We're friends now! What's your name?
nodes.why: Tell them your name: 我叫 + name. From now on they will greet you by it.

nodes.translate: {name} — a good name! I will remember it.

nodes.say: 你喜欢喝茶，我喜欢你！你叫什么名字？
nodes.translate: You like tea, so I like you! What is your name?
nodes.why: Tell them your name: 我叫 + name. From now on they will greet you by it.

nodes.translate: {name} — a good name! I will remember it.

nodes.say: 你叫什么名字？我叫小明！
nodes.translate: What's your name? I'm 小明!
nodes.why: Tell them your name: 我叫 + name. From now on they will greet you by it.

nodes.translate: {name} — a good name! I will remember it.

nodes.say: 你是王阿姨家的吧？你叫什么名字？
nodes.translate: You're staying at 王阿姨's, right? What's your name?
nodes.why: Tell them your name: 我叫 + name. From now on they will greet you by it.

nodes.translate: {name} — a good name! I will remember it.
{name}, you're back! Have you eaten?
nodes.why: Friends greet you by name. Just a hello — a talk a day warms the friendship.

nodes.translate: Hello, {name}! Nice weather today.
nodes.why: Friends greet you by name. Just a hello — a talk a day warms the friendship.

nodes.translate: Hello, {name}! My bird is happy today.
nodes.why: Friends greet you by name. Just a hello — a talk a day warms the friendship.

nodes.translate: {name}, you came! Sit, sit, have some tea!
nodes.why: Friends greet you by name. Just a hello — a talk a day warms the friendship.

nodes.translate: {name}! Let's play together!
nodes.why: Friends greet you by name. Just a hello — a talk a day warms the friendship.

nodes.translate: Hello, {name}! What are you buying today?
nodes.why: Friends greet you by name. Just a hello — a talk a day warms the friendship.

nodes.translate: {name}, look — this is my son.
nodes.why: She is showing you a photo on her phone.

nodes.say: 他在国外工作，三年没回家了。我很想他。
nodes.translate: He works abroad; he hasn't been home for three years. I miss him a lot.
nodes.why: 想 + a person is "to miss". 三年没回家 — "three years not come home": 没 with a time span before it means "for that long, not".

nodes.say: 打电话？这个新手机，我不会……
nodes.translate: Call him? This new phone — I can't work it…

nodes.say: 好！明天早上你来，我们一起给他打电话。
nodes.translate: Good! Come tomorrow morning, and we'll call him together.

nodes.say: {name}，你来了！手机在这儿，你来打吧。
nodes.translate: {name}, you came! Here's the phone — you make the call.
Hello? Son! It's Mum! …How are you?
nodes.why: 喂 (wéi) is how you answer or start a phone call.

nodes.translate: He says he's coming home for the New Year this year!
nodes.why: 过年 — "to pass the year" — is spending the Spring Festival at home with family.

nodes.say: 谢谢你，{name}！你真是我的好孩子。
nodes.translate: Thank you, {name}! You're like my own child.

nodes.say: {name}，我的第一个理发店不在这儿。
nodes.translate: {name}, my first barber shop wasn't here.

nodes.say: 那个理发店很小，里面有一个椅子。
nodes.translate: That shop was tiny — one chair inside.

nodes.say: 我的第一个客人是赵爷爷。三十年前！
nodes.translate: My first customer was 赵爷爷. Thirty years ago!

nodes.say: 现在那儿没有了。我也没有照片……
nodes.translate: It's all gone now. And I don't have a photo…
nodes.why: Maybe his first customer kept something from those days?

nodes.say: 好啊，你去问问他，他有没有照片。
nodes.translate: Good idea — go and ask him if he has a photo.

nodes.say: 张师傅的第一个理发店？我有照片！
nodes.translate: 张师傅's first barber shop? I have a photo!

nodes.say: 你看，这是三十年前的理发店的照片。有张师傅，也有我。
nodes.translate: Look — a photo of the shop thirty years ago. There's 张师傅, and me.
Take it and show him!

hint.full: 这是你的理发店的照片。

nodes.translate: What's that in your hand?

nodes.say: 这是我的第一个理发店！那个时候我二十岁……
nodes.translate: My first barber shop! I was twenty then…

nodes.say: 谢谢你，{name}。我每天都要看这个照片。
nodes.translate: Thank you, {name}. I will look at this photo every day.

onEnter.note: brought him the photo of his first shop

nodes.translate: {name}, this bird was my wife's.
She has passed away, and the bird does not sing any more.
nodes.why: 走了 — "has gone" — is a soft way to say someone has died.

nodes.say: 每天早上，她在鼓楼唱歌，鸟也唱。

nodes.translate: Every morning she sang at 鼓楼, and the bird sang too.
All right. Tomorrow morning, at 鼓楼.
You came! Listen — the bird…
The bird is singing! It's singing!

onEnter.note: heard his bird sing again on 鼓楼

nodes.translate: Thank you, {name}. She is here too, isn’t she?
It's raining! Do you have an umbrella?
nodes.why: 李阿姨’s corner shop on 南锣鼓巷 sells umbrellas.

words.explain: 下雨的时候，拿在手上，不让雨到身上。

nodes.translate: It's raining! And I have no umbrella…
nodes.why: He is stuck under the eaves. If you have an umbrella, use it on him from your bag.

words.explain: 下雨的时候，拿在手上，不让雨到身上。

nodes.say: 你的雨伞给我？太好了，谢谢你！
nodes.translate: Your umbrella, for me? Wonderful — thank you!

nodes.translate: Happy New Year! It’s the Spring Festival.
nodes.why: 过年好 — "good passing of the year" — is the Beijing way to wish a happy new year; 新年快乐 works too.

nodes.translate: We're having dumplings! Here's yours.

nodes.say: 你家门上还没有春联和福吧？李阿姨那儿有。
nodes.translate: There are no couplets or 福 on your gate yet, are there? 李阿姨 sells them.

nodes.say: 还有，给小明一个红包吧！
nodes.translate: And give 小明 a red envelope!
nodes.why: Children get 红包 with money from grown-ups at New Year — and they say 新年快乐 for it.

words.explain: 春节的时候，门两边的红纸，上面有字。
红色的小纸包，里面有钱。

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: The couplets are up on the gate! They look lovely.

words.explain: 春节的时候，门两边的红纸，上面有字。

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 你看，福倒了！福倒了——福到了！
nodes.translate: Look — the 福 is upside down! 福倒了, upside-down luck, sounds just like 福到了, luck has come!
nodes.why: 倒 dào (upside down) and 到 dào (arrive) sound the same. So people hang the 福 on the door upside down on purpose: “luck has arrived”.

nodes.translate: A red envelope? For me?
nodes.why: When you give a 红包 you say a wish with it: 新年快乐!

nodes.translate: Thank you! Happy New Year!

words.explain: 红色的小纸包，里面有钱。
春节的时候说的话：新的一年，你要快乐！

nodes.say: 今天是元宵节！吃元宵，看灯谜。
nodes.translate: It's the Lantern Festival! Sweet rice balls, and lantern riddles.

nodes.say: 一个灯谜：两个“木”，是什么字？
nodes.translate: A lantern riddle: two 木 — which character is it?
nodes.why: Two 木 (tree) side by side make 林 lín, a wood. 灯谜 are riddles hung on lanterns at 元宵.

nodes.say: 对了！是“林”！这个元宵给你。
nodes.translate: Right! It’s 林! Have a sweet rice ball.

words.explain: 元宵节吃的东西，小小的，圆的，很甜。
写在灯上的问题，你要想一想。

nodes.say: 今天是中秋节！晚上我们看月亮，吃月饼。
nodes.translate: It's the Mid-Autumn Festival! Tonight we look at the moon and eat mooncakes.

nodes.say: 这个月饼给你。晚上吃月饼，看月亮！
nodes.translate: This mooncake is for you. Tonight — mooncakes and the moon!
nodes.why: 中秋 is about the family being together — 团圆, “round and whole” — like the full moon.

words.explain: 中秋节吃的东西，圆的，像月亮。
晚上在天上，很亮，有的时候是圆的。

nodes.say: 今天是七夕。牛郎和织女在一起！
nodes.translate: It’s Qixi. The Cowherd and the Weaver Girl are together today!
nodes.why: 牛郎 and 织女 are two stars kept apart by the Milky Way; once a year magpies make a bridge so they can meet.

nodes.translate: It's snowing! Let's make a snowman!

nodes.say: 你做雪人的头，我来做大的。
nodes.translate: You make the snowman's head, I'll make the big part.
Done! Look — our snowman!

nodes.simpler: 买一点儿好看的东西吧！
nodes.translate: There's nothing in your room! Buy a few nice things.

nodes.say: 李阿姨那儿有花。花很好看！
nodes.translate: 李阿姨 has flowers. Flowers are lovely!
nodes.why: Around the city: flowers and paper-cuts at 李阿姨’s, a lantern at 潘家园, calligraphy at the 王府井 bookshop, an opera mask at the 前门 theatre. Use one on a spot in your room.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 你看，一只小猫！它想吃东西。
nodes.translate: Look — a little cat! It wants something to eat.
nodes.why: The hutong cats are shy. Feed it on a few different days and it will trust you — 李阿姨 sells 小鱼干, dried fish.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 小猫看着你。它想吃东西。
nodes.translate: The little cat is watching you. It wants something to eat.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 小猫吃了小鱼干！它很高兴。
nodes.translate: The little cat ate the dried fish! It is happy.

words.explain: 很小的鱼，干的，猫很喜欢吃。

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 它今天吃了。明天再给它吧。
nodes.translate: It has eaten today. Give it some tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 它是你的朋友了！它叫什么名字？
nodes.translate: It's your friend now! What is it called?
nodes.why: Give it any name: 它叫 + the name. 小花 (little flower), 小白 (whitey) and 咪咪 are what Beijing cats are often called.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 好名字！它会和你一起回家。
nodes.translate: A good name! It will come home with you.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: Purr, purr… it is happy.
Can your phone take photos?

nodes.say: 你能给我拍鼓楼的照片吗？我想给我的朋友看。
nodes.translate: Could you take a photo of the Drum Tower for me? I want to show my friend.
nodes.why: Tap 📷 in the top bar on the 鼓楼 square, put the Drum Tower inside the frame, and take it. Then come back to 小明.

nodes.say: 你拍了鼓楼的照片！真好看！
nodes.translate: You took a photo of the Drum Tower! It looks great!

nodes.say: 谢谢你！我的朋友会很高兴。
nodes.translate: Thank you! My friend will be so happy.

onEnter.note: photographed the Drum Tower for him

nodes.say: 你要去长城？我不能去了。
nodes.translate: You are going to the Great Wall? I can’t go any more.

nodes.say: 你给我拍长城的照片吧！我想看看。
nodes.translate: Take a photo of the Wall for me! I would like to see it.
nodes.why: On the Great Wall, tap 📷 and put the watchtower in the frame.

nodes.say: 这是长城的照片！真好看……
nodes.translate: A photo of the Great Wall! How beautiful…
Thank you, {name}. Here — have some tea!

onEnter.note: brought him a photo of the Great Wall

nodes.say: 来，我们下象棋！马走“日”，象走“田”。
nodes.translate: Come, a game of chess! The horse moves like 日, the elephant like 田.
nodes.why: 马走日: the horse goes one step and one diagonal — the shape of 日. 象走田: the elephant two diagonal steps — the shape of 田.

nodes.say: 我的炮在这儿。你的马可以吃我的炮！你走马，还是走象？
nodes.simpler: 你走马，还是走象？象走田。
nodes.translate: Look, my cannon is here. Your horse can take my cannon! What do you move?

nodes.say: 好！马吃炮！你的象棋真好！
nodes.translate: Good! Horse takes cannon! You play well!
Come and dance! Follow me: left!
nodes.why: 广场舞, square dancing: every evening the aunties dance on the squares. Do what she calls.

nodes.translate: Right!
Forward!
Back!
Clap! Clap!

nodes.say: 你的跳舞真好！明天晚上再来！
nodes.translate: Well danced! Come again tomorrow evening!

nodes.say: 来，我们包饺子！第一，和面。
nodes.translate: Come, let’s make dumplings together! First, mix the dough.
Then roll the wrappers.
And last — wrap them!

nodes.say: 你包的饺子真好看！过年好！
nodes.translate: You wrap them beautifully! Happy New Year!
nodes.why: 和面 mix, 擀皮 roll, 包 wrap — every family in the north makes 饺子 together on New Year’s Eve.

nodes.translate: Let me do a bit of crosstalk for you!

nodes.say: “你吃了吗？”“吃了。”“吃了什么？”“我吃亏了！”
nodes.translate: “Have you eaten?” “I have!” “What did you eat?” “A big loss!”
nodes.why: 吃 “eat” is also what you do to a loss: 吃亏 is “to eat a loss”, to come off worse. So the answer to “what did you eat?” is a joke. 相声 lives on puns like this.

nodes.say: 哈哈，你听懂了！这是相声。
nodes.translate: You got it! That’s what 相声 is.

nodes.say: 你好！我找帽儿胡同十三号，是哪个门？
nodes.translate: Hi! I’m looking for 帽儿胡同 number 13 — which door is it?
Number thirteen! Thank you!

onEnter.note: showed him the way to number 13

words.explain: 门上的数字，你家是几号？

nodes.say: 收——旧手机、旧电脑、旧书！我是收破烂儿的。
nodes.translate: Buying — old phones, old computers, old books! I’m the recycler.
Have you got anything old?

nodes.say: 没关系！明天早上我还来。你听到“收破烂儿”，是我来了！
nodes.translate: No matter! I come every morning. Listen — when I come I call “收破烂儿”!
Good! Give it to me next time. I come every morning.

nodes.say: 我叫祥子。我想要一个自己的三轮车。
nodes.translate: I'm 祥子. I want a tricycle of my own.
nodes.why: Homage to 老舍’s novel 《骆驼祥子》 (Rickshaw Boy, 1937): 祥子 pulls a rickshaw in old Beijing and saves, again and again, for a cart of his own. This 祥子 is a new, luckier one.

nodes.say: 今天你来拉客人吧！客人去哪儿，我们去哪儿。
nodes.translate: Today you take the fares! Wherever the passenger goes, we go.

nodes.speaker: tourist-1
nodes.translate: Hello! To the Drum Tower, please.

nodes.speaker: tourist-2
nodes.translate: To 后海, please!

nodes.say: 好！客人给了三十块。谢谢你！三轮车，快有了！
nodes.translate: Good! The passengers gave us thirty yuan. Thank you! My savings have grown!

onEnter.note: pedalled his tricycle for a morning

words.explain: 三个轮子的车，可以拉人。

nodes.say: 你看新闻了吗？今天的新闻……
nodes.translate: Have you seen the news? Today’s news…
nodes.why: Homage to 老舍’s play 《茶馆》 (Teahouse, 1957): the old teahouse hung a notice, 莫谈国事 — “don’t talk about affairs of state”. A good guest steers the talk to the weather and food.

nodes.say: 对，对，天气很好！我们喝茶吧。
nodes.translate: Yes, yes, lovely weather! Let’s drink our tea.

nodes.say: 在茶馆，我们说天气，说吃的，不说新闻。
nodes.translate: In a teahouse we talk about the weather and food, not the news.

nodes.say: 来，听我说书！那个时候，有三个好朋友：刘备、关羽、张飞。
nodes.translate: Come, listen to a story! Long ago there were three men: 刘备, 关羽 and 张飞.
nodes.why: Homage to 《三国演义》 (Romance of the Three Kingdoms). 说书, storytelling, was the teahouse’s radio: one episode a day, always stopping at the best moment. Come back tomorrow.

nodes.say: 他们喝酒，说：“我们是兄弟！”
nodes.translate: They drank together in a garden and said: “We are brothers!”
nodes.why: 桃园结义, the Oath of the Peach Garden: three strangers swear to be brothers.

nodes.say: 三个兄弟！今天说到这儿。明天再来听说书！
nodes.translate: That’s all for today. Come back tomorrow for more!

nodes.say: 你来了！今天：诸葛亮的城里没有人，敌人来了。
nodes.translate: You came! Today: 诸葛亮’s city is empty, and the enemy is coming.

nodes.say: 他开了城门，在城门上弹琴。
nodes.translate: He opened the city gate, and sat on top of it playing the zither.

nodes.say: 敌人看到了，说：“有很多人！”他们走了。
nodes.translate: The enemy saw him and said: “The city is full of soldiers!” And they left.
nodes.why: 空城计, the Empty City: 诸葛亮 was so calm that the enemy feared a trap.

nodes.translate: Do you like the Three Kingdoms?
Good! Come and listen often!

words.explain: 很多人住的大地方，有城门。

nodes.say: 今天是七夕。牛郎和织女要见面，要很多喜鹊。
nodes.translate: It’s Qixi. The Cowherd and the Weaver Girl meet today — and they need lots of magpies.

nodes.say: 你看到喜鹊，告诉它们：去天上！
nodes.translate: If you see a magpie, tell it: go up to the sky!
nodes.why: 牛郎 and 织女 are kept apart by the Milky Way; once a year, on the seventh night of the seventh month, magpies make a bridge. They were seen in the parks: 景山, 北海 and 天坛.

words.explain: 黑白色的鸟，中国人说它是好鸟。
两个人到一起，看到对方。

nodes.translate: Look at the sky! A bridge of magpies!

nodes.say: 牛郎和织女在桥上见面了。谢谢你！
nodes.translate: The Cowherd and the Weaver Girl meet on the bridge. Thank you!

words.explain: 黑白色的鸟，中国人说它是好鸟。
在水上，人从上面走过去。
两个人到一起，看到对方。

nodes.say: 我们做月饼吧！第一，放馅儿。
nodes.translate: Let’s make mooncakes! First, the filling.
Good! The mooncakes are made.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 我给你说我的故事。月亮上有嫦娥。
nodes.simpler: 我的故事：月亮上有嫦娥。
nodes.translate: Let me tell you my story. On the moon there is a woman called 嫦娥.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 嫦娥有一个兔子，叫玉兔。玉兔是我的……朋友！
nodes.translate: 嫦娥 has a white rabbit called the Jade Rabbit. The Jade Rabbit is my… friend!
nodes.why: 嫦娥 flew to the moon; her jade rabbit pounds medicine there. Beijing’s clay 兔儿爷 is said to be the Jade Rabbit come down to cure the city — which is why he is so proud at 中秋.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 中秋节，你看月亮，可以看到兔子！
nodes.translate: At Mid-Autumn, look at the moon and you can see the Jade Rabbit!

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: A little shrine, very old. Nobody comes.

words.explain: 很小的庙，人们在里面说自己想要的。

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: The little shrine is half mended.

words.explain: 很小的庙，人们在里面说自己想要的。

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 小庙里有长明灯，晚上也很好看。
nodes.translate: The lamp in the little shrine never goes out.

words.explain: 很小的庙，人们在里面说自己想要的。

nodes.say: 你好。我姓白。我是收破烂儿的。
nodes.translate: Hello. My name is Bai. I collect old things with the recycler.
nodes.why: Homage to 墨香铜臭’s novel 《天官赐福》 (Heaven Official’s Blessing): an unlucky god in white who collects scrap and never complains, and a man in red with silver butterflies. The characters here are new; the blessing itself, 天官赐福, is real folk custom — the Heavenly Official’s gift at the Lantern Festival.

nodes.translate: Ah… everything I was carrying has fallen.
Never mind. 百无禁忌 — nothing is unlucky!
nodes.why: 百无禁忌: “a hundred things, none forbidden” — what you say when something goes wrong and you refuse to call it a bad sign.

nodes.say: 胡同东边有一个小庙，没有人去。你能帮我吗？
nodes.simpler: 胡同里的小庙，你帮我吗？
nodes.translate: At the east end of the lane there’s a little shrine, very old, nobody goes. Could you help me?

nodes.say: 谢谢你！小庙要木头、红布和香。你问问你的朋友吧。
nodes.translate: Thank you! The shrine needs wood, red cloth and incense. Ask your friends.

words.explain: 很小的庙，人们在里面说自己想要的。
点了有好闻的味道，在庙里用。

nodes.say: 小庙？我有一些木头，给你吧！
nodes.translate: The shrine? I have some old wood — take it!

words.explain: 很小的庙，人们在里面说自己想要的。

nodes.translate: Red cloth? I have some! Here — for the shrine.

words.explain: 很小的庙，人们在里面说自己想要的。

nodes.say: 香？我这儿有。给小庙的，不要钱。
nodes.translate: Incense? I have some. For the shrine — no charge.

words.explain: 点了有好闻的味道，在庙里用。
很小的庙，人们在里面说自己想要的。

nodes.say: 木头、红布、香，都有了！我们一起做吧！
nodes.translate: Wood, red cloth, incense — we have it all! Let’s do it together!

nodes.say: ……小庙好了一半！下雨了？百无禁忌！
nodes.translate: …The shrine is half mended! Oh — it’s raining. 百无禁忌!

nodes.say: 晚上，你再来看看小庙吧。
nodes.translate: Come and look at the shrine again this evening.

words.explain: 点了有好闻的味道，在庙里用。
很小的庙，人们在里面说自己想要的。

nodes.say: 你也来看小庙？它很漂亮。
nodes.translate: You’ve come to see the shrine too? It used to be beautiful.

nodes.say: 晚上胡同里很黑。我的银蝶给你，它们给你带路。
nodes.simpler: 胡同很黑，银蝶给你带路。
nodes.translate: The lanes are dark at night. My silver butterflies are yours — they’ll light your way.
nodes.why: From tonight two silver butterflies circle you after dark.

nodes.translate: My motto: 所向披靡 — nothing stands in my way!

nodes.say: 小庙还要一个长明灯。潘家园晚上有一个鬼市，那儿有长明灯。
nodes.translate: The shrine still needs an ever-burning lamp. At night 潘家园 becomes a ghost market — there’s one there.

words.explain: 银色的小蝴蝶，晚上会亮。
晚上的市场，很奇怪的东西都有。
很小的庙，人们在里面说自己想要的。

nodes.say: 长明灯在小庙里……好了！小庙好了！
nodes.translate: The ever-burning lamp goes in the shrine… there! The shrine is mended!
Look at the sky!

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 很多很多灯！我的灯笼，现在好了！
nodes.translate: Lanterns, so many! And my lantern — it’s mended now!
nodes.why: On 元宵 night people send lanterns up into the sky; 兔儿爷’s own lantern — the one that broke in chapter 1 — is mended too.

nodes.speaker: hong-xiansheng
nodes.translate: A happy 上元.
Thank you. 天官赐福 — may Heaven’s Official bless you!

words.explain: 很小的庙，人们在里面说自己想要的。

nodes.speaker: li-ayi
nodes.translate: You’ve come to help? Good! The water goes on top.
nodes.why: Stack the shelves the way she says. 上面 on top, 下面 underneath.

nodes.speaker: li-ayi
nodes.translate: The bread goes underneath.

nodes.speaker: li-ayi
nodes.translate: Thanks for helping! Here’s ten yuan.

nodes.speaker: speaker-box
nodes.translate: Alipay: 10 元 received.

nodes.speaker: zaodian-shifu
nodes.say: 来帮忙！人太多了！这个客人要两个包子。
nodes.translate: Come and help — so many people! This customer wants two buns.
nodes.why: Hand out what each customer ordered.

nodes.speaker: zaodian-shifu
nodes.say: 那个客人要一杯豆浆，一根油条。

options.label: 🥛 + 🥖 soy milk and a dough stick
🥟 + 🥖 a bun and a dough stick

nodes.translate: That customer wants a soy milk and a fried dough stick.

nodes.speaker: zaodian-shifu
nodes.say: 谢谢你帮忙！给你十五块。
nodes.translate: Thanks for helping! Here’s fifteen yuan.

nodes.speaker: speaker-box
nodes.translate: Alipay: 15 元 received.

words.explain: 长的东西说“一根”：一根油条。

nodes.speaker: lao-liu
nodes.say: 你来帮忙？好！三号桌要茶。
nodes.translate: You’ll help? Good! Table three wants tea.

nodes.speaker: lao-liu
nodes.translate: Table five wants water.

nodes.speaker: lao-liu
nodes.translate: Thanks for helping! Here’s ten yuan.

nodes.speaker: speaker-box
nodes.translate: Alipay: 10 元 received.

words.explain: 吃饭、喝茶的时候用的，上面放东西。

nodes.say: 我太忙了！你帮我送一个吧：八号。
nodes.translate: I’m so busy! Deliver one for me: number eight.
Thank you! Here’s five yuan.

nodes.speaker: speaker-box
nodes.translate: Alipay: 5 元 received.
Got anything old? I’ll take it all!
nodes.why: Name something in your bag (「我有保温杯」); he offers half what it cost — 「好」 and the money arrives on your phone. Story things are not for sale.

nodes.say: 新年快乐！这个红包给你。
nodes.translate: Happy New Year! This red envelope is for you.
nodes.why: At New Year the older ones give the younger ones 红包 with money in — you say 谢谢 and a wish back.

nodes.translate: Good kid!

words.explain: 红色的小纸包，里面有钱。
春节的时候说的话：新的一年，你要快乐！

nodes.translate: Happy New Year! A red envelope for you!
Ha ha, good!

words.explain: 红色的小纸包，里面有钱。

quests.title: A new home in the hutong

steps.now: Go out into the courtyard and say hello to 王阿姨, your landlady.
steps.past: Stepped out into the courtyard and met 王阿姨, my landlady.

steps.now: Have breakfast at the 早点铺 on 南锣鼓巷: out of the courtyard gate, then east along the lane.
steps.past: Had 包子 and 豆浆 at the 早点铺 — my first order in Chinese.

steps.now: Go back to the courtyard and look at 王阿姨's old lantern.
steps.past: Looked at 王阿姨's old lantern — and it broke, and something ran out of it.

steps.now: The lantern's spirits have run off. Ask people if they have seen anything strange — the teahouse 茶馆 and the corner shop 小卖部 on 南锣鼓巷 hear everything.
steps.past: Asked around the lanes until someone had seen something strange.

steps.now: They say the stone lion by the Drum Tower 鼓楼 moves at night. Ask the way if you need to (it is west of your lane), and go after dark — 老刘 at the teahouse lets you sit till evening.
steps.past: Went to the 鼓楼 after dark and made friends with the stone lion.

steps.now: The spirits could be anywhere in Beijing. Buy a 交通卡 at 南锣鼓巷 station, at the east end of the lanes.
steps.past: Bought my own 交通卡 at 南锣鼓巷 station.

steps.now: Take the subway to 天安门东: through the gates (tap your card), find the board on the platform, line 8 south to 王府井, then line 1 one stop.
steps.past: Rode the subway — line 8, then line 1 — all the way to 天安门.

steps.now: 王阿姨 is getting the courtyard ready for 春节. (This chapter is still being written — the story goes on to the Great Wall for now.)
steps.past: Heard 王阿姨 getting ready for 春节 — a chapter still to come.

quests.title: 赵爷爷’s bird
quests.blurb: 赵爷爷's songbird flew out of its cage. It is his oldest friend, and the lanes are quiet without it.
quests.lead: 赵爷爷 on 南锣鼓巷 is staring at an empty cage.

steps.now: 赵爷爷’s bird flew off. The kid 小明 plays in the lanes — ask him.
steps.past: 小明 helped me find 赵爷爷's bird.

steps.now: Take the bird back to 赵爷爷 on 南锣鼓巷.
steps.past: Gave the bird back to 赵爷爷 — it sang at once.

quests.title: A haircut
quests.blurb: 张师傅 has cut hair on 南锣鼓巷 for thirty years, and he thinks yours could do with a trim.
quests.lead: The barber 张师傅 on 南锣鼓巷 has an empty chair.

steps.now: Get a haircut at 张师傅’s on 南锣鼓巷 (30 元).
steps.past: Had my hair cut at 张师傅's — and said how I wanted it.

quests.title: 小明’s kite
quests.blurb: 小明's kite is stuck high in a tree, and he is too small to reach it.
quests.lead: 小明 keeps looking up at the trees in 帽儿胡同.

steps.now: 小明’s kite is stuck in the 槐树 of 帽儿胡同. Buy a bamboo pole 竹竿 at the corner shop and use it on the kite (🎒 → Use).
steps.past: Got 小明's kite out of the tree with a bamboo pole.

steps.now: Give the kite back to 小明 (🎒 → Use on him).
steps.past: Gave 小明 his kite back.

quests.title: Lost keys
quests.blurb: My keys were gone one morning. Someone in the lanes must have seen them.
quests.lead: Your pocket feels light — have you seen your keys?

steps.now: Your keys are gone. Ask the neighbours if they have seen them.
steps.past: Asked the neighbours about my keys; 小明 had seen them.

steps.now: 小明 saw them in the dark corner of 帽儿胡同. A torch 手电筒 from the corner shop — use it on the corner.
steps.past: Found my keys in a dark corner of 帽儿胡同 with a torch.

quests.title: A photo for 王阿姨
quests.blurb: 王阿姨 grew up near an old red gate and would love a photo of one like it.
quests.lead: 王阿姨 in the courtyard is talking about the red gates of her childhood.

steps.now: 王阿姨 wants a photo of a red gate. Use your 手机 on the door gods’ gate in 大栅栏.
steps.past: Took a photo of the door gods' red gate in 大栅栏.

steps.now: Show 王阿姨 the photo (use your 手机 on her).
steps.past: Showed 王阿姨 the photo — she looked at it for a long time.

quests.title: 王阿姨’s son
quests.blurb: 王阿姨's son lives far away. She misses him and is shy about calling.
quests.lead: 王阿姨 looks at her phone a lot, and sighs.

steps.now: 王阿姨 misses her son abroad. Listen to her — maybe she could call him?
steps.past: 王阿姨 told me about her son abroad.

steps.now: Come back to the courtyard in the morning (7–11) and help 王阿姨 call her son.
steps.past: Helped 王阿姨 call her son — she laughed all morning.

quests.title: The first barber shop
quests.blurb: 张师傅 remembers his very first barber shop and the first man who sat in his chair.
quests.lead: 张师傅 at the barber's has a story, if you are a friend.

steps.now: 张师傅 is telling you about his first shop.
steps.past: 张师傅 told me about his first shop.

steps.now: His first customer was 赵爷爷. Ask 赵爷爷 on 南锣鼓巷 about the old shop.
steps.past: Asked 赵爷爷 about the old shop — he still had a photo.

steps.now: Take 赵爷爷’s old photo to 张师傅 at the barber’s.
steps.past: Brought 赵爷爷's old photo to 张师傅.

quests.title: The bird that stopped singing
quests.blurb: 赵爷爷's bird has stopped singing, and he has a morning ritual that might bring its song back.
quests.lead: 赵爷爷 says his bird has gone quiet.

steps.now: 赵爷爷 is telling you about his bird.
steps.past: 赵爷爷 told me about his bird that stopped singing.

steps.now: Meet 赵爷爷 on the 鼓楼 square in the early morning (6–9).
steps.past: Met 赵爷爷 on the 鼓楼 square at dawn — the bird sang again.

quests.title: Caught in the rain
quests.blurb: 赵爷爷 was caught in the rain without an umbrella, and he will not ask for help.
quests.lead: On rainy days 赵爷爷 stands under the eaves on 南锣鼓巷.

steps.now: 赵爷爷 has no umbrella. 李阿姨 sells them on rainy days — use one on him from your bag.
steps.past: Lent 赵爷爷 an umbrella in the rain.

steps.now: 赵爷爷 will give your umbrella back on a dry day. Look for him on 南锣鼓巷.
steps.past: 赵爷爷 gave my umbrella back on a dry day.

quests.title: New Year at the courtyard
quests.blurb: At New Year every gate in the hutong gets red couplets and a 福 — and children get 红包.
quests.lead: 王阿姨 is counting the days to New Year.

steps.now: Put 春联 and a 福 on your gate: buy them at 李阿姨’s in winter, then use them on a lantern beside your red gate in 帽儿胡同.
steps.past: Put 春联 and a 福 on my red gate for New Year.

steps.now: Give 小明 a 红包 (李阿姨 sells them) and wish him a happy new year — during 春节 or 元宵.
steps.past: Gave 小明 a 红包 and wished him a happy new year.
steps.when: at 春节 or 元宵

quests.title: A room of your own
quests.blurb: My room is bare. 王阿姨 thinks a home should have something nice in it.
quests.lead: 王阿姨 thinks your room looks a little empty.

steps.now: Buy something nice for your room — flowers or a paper-cut at 李阿姨’s, a lantern at 潘家园, calligraphy at the 王府井 bookshop, an opera mask at the 前门 theatre — and use it on a spot in your room (墙, 窗户, 地上).
steps.past: Made my room nicer with something I bought.

steps.now: Talk to 王阿姨 — she wants to see your room.
steps.past: Showed 王阿姨 my room — she approved.

quests.title: The hutong cat
quests.blurb: A thin little cat lives in 帽儿胡同. It is shy, but food helps.
quests.lead: Something small and furry watches you in 帽儿胡同.

steps.now: Feed the little cat in 帽儿胡同 on three different days: buy 小鱼干 at 李阿姨’s and use it on the cat.
steps.past: Fed the hutong cat on three days until it trusted me.

steps.now: The cat trusts you. Look at it and give it a name: 它叫……
steps.past: Gave the cat a name.

quests.title: A photo for 小明
quests.blurb: 小明 wants a good photo of the Drum Tower for his school project.
quests.lead: 小明 in 帽儿胡同 needs a picture for school.

steps.now: Take a photo of the Drum Tower 鼓楼 for 小明: tap 📷 on the 鼓楼 square and put the tower in the frame.
steps.past: Took a photo of the Drum Tower for 小明.

steps.now: Show 小明 the photo — he is in 帽儿胡同.
steps.past: Showed 小明 the Drum Tower photo.

quests.title: The Wall for 老刘
quests.blurb: 老刘 has never been to the Great Wall and would love to see a photo of it.
quests.lead: 老刘 at the teahouse talks about the Great Wall as if it were far away.

steps.now: Take a photo of the Great Wall’s watchtower for 老刘: tap 📷 on the Wall.
steps.past: Photographed the Wall's watchtower for 老刘.

steps.now: Show 老刘 the photo at the teahouse.
steps.past: Showed 老刘 the Wall — he poured me a cup of his best tea.

quests.title: A game of 象棋
quests.blurb: An old man plays Chinese chess on the lane every day and is always looking for a new opponent.
quests.lead: An old man on 南锣鼓巷 sits over a chess board, waiting.

steps.now: Play Chinese chess with the old man on 南锣鼓巷 — say which piece you move.
steps.past: Played a game of 象棋 on the lane.

quests.title: Square dancing
quests.blurb: Every evening the aunties dance on the 鼓楼 square, and anyone can join.
quests.lead: Music drifts over the 鼓楼 square in the evenings.

steps.now: In the evening, dance with the aunties on the 鼓楼 square — do what she calls.
steps.past: Danced with the aunties on the 鼓楼 square.

quests.title: Dumplings with 王阿姨
quests.blurb: At New Year 王阿姨 makes dumplings, and she needs another pair of hands.
quests.lead: 王阿姨 says New Year is not New Year without dumplings.

steps.now: At New Year, make dumplings with 王阿姨 — do each step she says.
steps.past: Made dumplings with 王阿姨 for New Year.

quests.title: A bit of 相声
quests.blurb: 老刘 loves 相声, comic dialogue, and has a joke he has been saving for you.
quests.lead: 老刘 at the teahouse is grinning about something.

steps.now: 老刘 at the teahouse has a joke for you. Listen, and laugh if you get it.
steps.past: Listened to 老刘's 相声 — and got the joke.

quests.title: The lost delivery
quests.blurb: A delivery rider is lost in the hutong maze with someone's dinner going cold.
quests.lead: In the evening a delivery rider circles 帽儿胡同 again and again.

steps.now: The delivery rider in 帽儿胡同 (in the evening) cannot find a house number — help him.
steps.past: Helped the delivery rider find the right house.

quests.title: Old things for sale
quests.blurb: A recycler rides through the hutong each morning, buying old things by the kilo.
quests.lead: In the mornings someone calls out 「收破烂儿」 in 帽儿胡同.

steps.now: In the morning a recycler rides through 帽儿胡同 calling out — talk to him.
steps.past: Talked to the recycler in 帽儿胡同.

quests.title: 《骆驼祥子》 — a cart of his own
quests.blurb: 祥子 pulls a hired tricycle and dreams of owning one — like the rickshaw man in the old novel.
quests.lead: A tricycle driver on 南锣鼓巷 works very hard.

steps.now: 祥子 on 南锣鼓巷 wants a tricycle of his own. Take his passengers where they ask.
steps.past: Helped 祥子 take his passengers where they asked.

quests.title: 《茶馆》 — don’t talk politics
quests.blurb: A guest in 老刘's teahouse keeps bringing up the news, though the notice on the wall says not to.
quests.lead: A guest in the teahouse talks a little too loudly.

steps.now: In 老刘’s teahouse a guest keeps bringing up the news. Mind the notice on the wall — talk about the weather or food.
steps.past: Kept the teahouse talk on the weather and the food.

quests.title: 《三国演义》 — the storyteller
quests.blurb: A storyteller tells the Three Kingdoms in the teahouse, one episode a day.
quests.lead: A storyteller sets up his table in 老刘's teahouse.

steps.now: The storyteller in 老刘’s teahouse tells one episode a day. Come back on another day for the next.
steps.past: Heard the storyteller's first episode.

steps.now: Hear the second episode at the teahouse.
steps.past: Came back for the second episode.

quests.title: Magpies for 七夕
quests.blurb: On 七夕 the magpies make a bridge in the sky so the cowherd and the weaver girl can meet.
quests.lead: 王阿姨 tells a story about magpies every summer.

steps.now: Find the three magpies — in the parks of 景山, 北海 and 天坛 — and send them to the bridge in the sky.
steps.past: Found the three magpies in the parks and sent them to the sky.

steps.now: Tell 王阿姨 — look at the sky together.
steps.past: Looked at the sky with 王阿姨 on 七夕.

quests.title: 兔儿爷’s story
quests.blurb: At the Mid-Autumn festival 王阿姨 makes mooncakes, and 兔儿爷 has a story of his own.
quests.lead: 兔儿爷 goes quiet when anyone mentions the moon.

steps.now: At 中秋, make mooncakes with 王阿姨 — and hear 兔儿爷’s own story.
steps.past: Made mooncakes with 王阿姨 and heard 兔儿爷's own story.

quests.title: 《天官赐福》 — the little shrine
quests.blurb: A quiet man in white is building a little shrine in the hutong. He says it is for someone who waits.
quests.lead: A man in white walks with the recycler in 帽儿胡同 on some mornings.

steps.now: A gentle man in white collects old things with the recycler in 帽儿胡同 in the mornings.
steps.past: Met 白先生, the gentle man in white.

steps.now: The shrine needs wood, red cloth and incense. Ask friends who like you (two hearts): 张师傅, 王阿姨, 李阿姨.
steps.past: Asked friends for wood, red cloth and incense for the shrine.

steps.now: Come back to the shrine in 帽儿胡同 after dark.
steps.past: Saw silver butterflies at the shrine after dark.

steps.now: Find the ever-burning lamp at the ghost market — 潘家园 after eight at night.
steps.past: Found the ever-burning lamp at the ghost market.

steps.now: On the night of 元宵 (the Lantern Festival), bring the lamp to 白先生 at the shrine.
steps.past: Brought the lamp to 白先生 on the night of 元宵.

legend.zh: 北京的大门口，常常有两个石狮子。人们说，石狮子晚上会醒，看着门，不让坏东西进来。
legend.en: At the great gates of Beijing there are often two stone lions. People say that at night the lions wake and watch the gate, and let nothing bad come in.

befriend.text: 一个日，一个月，是什么字？
befriend.en: A sun and a moon side by side — what character is that? (明, bright)

legend.zh: 元宵节的晚上，天官从天上来，给大家好的一年。人们说：“天官赐福！”
legend.en: On the night of 元宵 the Heavenly Official comes down and gives everyone a good year. People say: “天官赐福 — the Heavenly Official grants blessings!”

befriend.en: Help him mend the little shrine.

idioms.meaning: so-so; careless — neither good nor bad

story.zh: 以前有一个画家，画了一个头是虎、身子是马的画。别人问：“这是马还是虎？”他说：“马马虎虎！”
story.en: Long ago a painter drew an animal with a tiger's head and a horse's body. People asked, 'Is it a horse or a tiger?' He said, 'Horse-horse, tiger-tiger!' — and since then the words mean 'so-so, careless'.

idioms.meaning: wholeheartedly; with all your attention on one thing

story.zh: 做一个事的时候，只想这个事，不想别的，就是一心一意。老刘做茶的时候，就是这样。
story.en: When you do one thing and think only of it, not of anything else, that is 一心一意 — the way 老刘 makes tea.

idioms.meaning: nothing is unlucky — never mind, anything goes

story.zh: 有的人很怕不好的事。可是有的人说：“百无禁忌！”什么都不怕。
story.en: Some people are afraid of every bad omen. Others just say “百无禁忌!” — a hundred things, none forbidden — and carry on.

story.zh: 他去哪儿，别人就都倒了，像风里的草。
story.en: Wherever he went, everyone went down before him, like grass flattened by the wind.

idioms.meaning: in the space of a single thought — a moment decides

story.zh: 做好人还是做坏人，常常只在一个想法里。
story.en: Whether you become good or bad often comes down to a single thought.

items.name: 老照片
items.en: an old photo of the first barber shop

steps.en: Morning! You're new here, aren't you?
Yes. I live in 帽儿胡同.
Good, good! If you need anything, come and find me.
南锣鼓巷 — your lane now. Home is just round the corner, in 帽儿胡同.

steps.zh: 这个灯笼，是我爷爷做的。
steps.en: This lantern — my grandfather made it.

steps.zh: 我小的时候，元宵节的晚上，爷爷点上这个灯笼。
steps.en: When I was little, on the night of 元宵, Grandpa lit this lantern.

steps.zh: 灯笼上有一个小狮子。它一动，我很高兴！
steps.en: On the lantern there was a little lion. When it moved, I was so happy!
The lion was the first figure she ever chased. And the first one home.
Today the little lion has come back.

words.explain: 晚上用的红色的灯，门口有，过年也有。
一个很大的动物，大门口有石头做的。
